title: Pani nahi chahiye
body:
dhal gaya din wo takti rahi raasta
haath se daaman e sabr jaata raha
rukh kiya suye darya ye ro kar kaha
chacha jaan pani nahi chahiye
<<DIVIDER>>
bas ab aap darya se aa jaiye
chacha jaan pani nahi...
<<DIVIDER>>
meri pyaas to tum se bad kar nahi
mai mar jaungi mera karlo yaqeen
mujhe raas aayi na ye sar zameen
khudara na ab aur tadpaiye
chacha jaan pani nahi...
<<DIVIDER>>
chacha mujhko maloom hota agar
nahi aayenge aap bhi laut kar
to phir mashk deti nahi nauhagar
meri mashk khaali hi le aaiye
chacha jaan pani nahi...
<<DIVIDER>>
na jaane wo kaisi ghadi aayi thi
padar se ijazat jo dilwayi thi
mai khud apni ghurbat se ghabrayi thi
khata dar guzar meri farmaiye
chacha jaan pani nahi...
<<DIVIDER>>
chacha ye sakina ka waada raha
ke ab al-atash ki na dungi sada
bina aap ke hai ye jeena saza
jiyun kaise itna to batalaiye
chacha jaan pani nahi...
<<DIVIDER>>
sakina pe jaan dene waale chacha
kiya mujhko kiske hawale chacha
bhula dungi honton ke chaale chacha
mujhe aa ke seene se liptaiye
chacha jaan pani nahi...
<<DIVIDER>>
khabar aap ke qatl ki yun mili
mere baba jaan ki kamar jhuk gayi
rida phaynk ke ro rahi hai phupi
ye manzar zara dekhne aaiye
chacha jaan pani nahi...
<<DIVIDER>>
chidi mashk meri koi gham nahi
meri aas tooti koi gham nahi
mai pyasi rahungi koi gham nahi
dawa mere zakhmon ki ban jaiye
chacha jaan pani nahi...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye mazhar ye mesum ye ahle aza
yehi kehke karte hai matam bapa
ye jumla sakina ka hai marsiya
bas ab aap darya se aajaiye
chacha jaan pani nahi...
author: Mazhar Abidi
